startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Crunchbase URLs only. Use company/organization URLs (https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/company-name) or investor/person URLs (https://www.crunchbase.com/person/investor-name). Non-Crunchbase URLs will be skipped.

scrapingMode.title: Scraping Mode
scrapingMode.description: Select the type of data to extract. 'auto' detects automatically, 'crunchbase' for company data, 'investor' for investor profiles, 'business-listing' for M&A listings, 'general' for basic page data.

extractMAData.title: Extract M&A Data
extractMAData.description: Enable enhanced M&A-specific data extraction (revenue, valuation, deal readiness, business type). Useful for AnyBiz workflow.

discoverInvestors.title: Discover Investors
discoverInvestors.description: When enabled, crawls Crunchbase search results and listing pages to discover investor profiles automatically. Works with Crunchbase URLs that contain search results or investor listings.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of requests that can be made by this crawler.
